notes.title: Super Soccer Blast - Minor bug fixing
notes.content:
We know we said the last update was the last one... However, there were a few flaws remaining to fix with the previous patch so today we released a new patch fixing minor bugs:

- fixed bug when changing controls before kickoff
- now change all hair color in editor works
- fixed some german texts
- fixed some russian texts
- fixed crash in options
- fixed disappearing teams when changing their names
- now Change Player properly appears in Edit Squad buttons UI
- fixed avatar neck length to avoid visual glitch

We mean to keep our word said in our previous update, but since many of you asked about the future of the game, we want to give you a bit of hope. It's still soon to confirm anything yet and it's a bit up in the air, but do not be worried, this is not the end of Super Soccer Blast. Please, bear with us! 😉

notes.title: Last patch for Super Soccer Blast!!
notes.content:
We've been a bit quiet lately, but today we're glad to announce that we've been working on a new patch for Super Soccer Blast ⚽

This new patch includes: 

Now you can jump into a new grass pitch. New stadium added: The Cage!

As many of you had requested, we improved AI behaviors: kickoff passes, certain goalkeeper situations, scoring goals from too far, among others.

Another requested feature, more options for the avatar editor. You’ll find new noses, hairs and beards to customize your players. Looking forward to see your creations!

More responsive motions on shots and passes when sprinting.

Improved player placement during stopped balls.

Fixed bugs:
- Fixed a bug made the player able to change focus during free kicks
- Fixed a bug about some frames missing in tackles and dribbles
- Fixed minor bugs in player moves
- Fixed some UI errors

After this patch we are going to focus on new developments in the studio. As a humble and small team, we would like to thank you for supporting us all this time!! 

We hope you enjoy this new patch and stay tuned to our upcoming projects! (Some of them related to soccer/football 😉

notes.title: UPDATE: Bug fixing and increased max custom players and teams
notes.content:
It’s been a week since we released Super Soccer Blast. As you know, our main intent is to fix those few bugs that hinder the core experience of Super Soccer Blast. So, this week we’ve been working on a patch that fixes:

Fixed squad arrangement and position on field
Fixed stored hit error (it cancelled hit a lot of times)
Fixed achievements bug
Fixed menu issue in tournaments
Some ingame texts changed (like end time and others)
Increased max custom players and teams to 1000 and 150
Use triggers same as bumpers during gameplay
Fix "press L" icon in avatar editor for "set color to all hair"
Option to block fps and quality settings

After this patch, we’ll keep polishing the game. However, as you know, we’re just five guys and our bandwidth is limited so, please, bear with us and take into account that there are features that are harder to fix than others or even are way out of our league with our current resources.  

Thank you for all the feedback received. In the meanwhile, we hope this patch helps to improve the gameplay experience. As always thank you for your support and hope you have a blast playing our games :)
